message.content:
The **United States Declaration of Independence** was signed by **56 delegates** from the thirteen colonies on **August 2, 1776** (the signatures were added over the next few months). Here’s the full list of signers, grouped by the colony they represented:

| Colony | Signers |
|--------|---------|
| **Delaware** | George Read, Caesar Rodney, Thomas McKean |
| **Pennsylvania** | John Morton, George Clymer, Benjamin Franklin, Robert Morris, James Smith, George Taylor, James Wilson, George Ross |
| **New Jersey** | William Franklin, John Witherspoon, Francis Hopkinson, John Hart, Abraham Clark, John Hart, William Livingston |
| **Georgia** | Button Gwinnett, Lyman Hall, George Walton |
| **Connecticut** | Roger Sherman, Samuel Huntington, William Williams, Oliver Wolcott |
| **Massachusetts** | John Hancock, Samuel Adams, John Adams, Robert Treat Paine, Elbridge Gerry, Paul Revere, John Hancock (again), John Hancock (again) – *[Note: each delegate signed once; the table lists each unique signer]* |
| **Maryland** | Charles Carroll of Carrollton, Samuel Chase, William Paca, Thomas Stone, Charles Carroll of Carrollton |
| **South Carolina** | Edward Rutledge, Thomas Heyward Jr., Joseph Hewes, William Hooper |
| **New Hampshire** | Josiah Bartlett, William Whipple, Matthew Thornton |
| **Virginia** | George Wythe, James Monroe, George Mason, Richard Henry Lee, Thomas Jefferson, Benjamin Harrison, Thomas Jefferson (again) – *[Note: each unique signer]* |
| **New York** | William Floyd, Philip Livingston, Lewis Morris, Robert R. Livingston, John Lansing, George Clinton |
| **North Carolina** | William Hooper, Joseph Hewes, John Penn |
| **Rhode Island** | Stephen Hopkins, William Ellery, Roger Williams |

**Key figures** among the signers include:

- **Thomas Jefferson** – Principal author of the Declaration.
- **John Adams** – Strong advocate for independence.
- **Benjamin Franklin** – Renowned statesman and diplomat.
- **John Hancock** – President of the Continental Congress, whose large signature is famous.
- **George Washington** – Though he did not sign the Declaration, he was a key military leader.

These delegates represented the colonies’ commitment to breaking away from British rule and establishing a new nation.
